name: Tanetsuke Choukyou II
source:
The captain who is extremely proficient at battle tactics has taken along three pleasant companions.
A desire for whirlwind training along with an important and classified mission.
She must carry out her mission in order to attain victory, however command her freely to ignore her duties and model her to become your dog bitch sex slave, submitting to her desire...
